previous_candidate.explanation: The sole candidate-20 full-run failure was the new lit assertion expecting "violated" instead of the existing diagnostic "failed". Only that test expectation changed; all lit tests then passed. Original failure logs are retained.

The sole candidate-20 full-run failure was the new lit assertion expecting "violated" instead of the existing diagnostic "failed". Only that test expectation changed; all lit tests then passed. Original failure logs are retained.

candidate27_cold_and_cache.reason: Lua producer validation rejected checkpoint publication; redundant warm Lua analysis interrupted.

diagnostic_binary.purpose: Diagnostic instrumentation only; excluded from acceptance cost.

candidate28_cache_transport_fix.reason: The Lua request union contains 40 callback contexts; transport had conflated requests with the 32 computed-specialization limit. RFC 0028 gives request metadata a separate 65536-per-symbol bound, preserving all analysis limits. All three rejected records now round-trip canonically. A test-only temporary-string lint error was corrected and the rebuilt focused tests were rerun.

candidate28_failed_cost.reason: Lua timed out at 600.145 seconds during final completion, after all checkpoints were published. All five warm semantic reports match; 51 unit hits and zero function analyses. The timed-out cold invocation remains invalid coverage.

candidate29_serialization.reason: Streamed checkpoint units and diagnostics replace an intermediate JSON object tree. Owned hash indexes preserve shared table first-use ids and exact row equality. Producer validation, checksums and semantic limits remain unchanged. The independent table oracle and nested Unicode/control-text round trips pass; a test declaration-style lint issue was corrected.

candidate29_failed_ordinary_cost.reason: Extra copy-only setter requests inflated ordinary specialization. Candidate 30 limits this additional demand to checked-contract analysis, retaining ordinary symbolic stores and actual indirect-call requests.

ordinary_footprint_preparation.note: The probe remained above cost targets. Candidate 31 bounds call-input footprints at the unchanged 64-fact limit, returns explicit overflow, shares immutable prefixes and reuses up to 64 immutable preparations per function. A test omitted the required copy offset and a cache entry needed designated initialization; both were corrected. Profiles, overlapping diagnostic counters and comparator microbenchmarks are excluded from acceptance cost.

path_backing_allocation.note: The standard shared-array experiment increased memory and was replaced. Candidate 33 retains size_t lengths, uses checked aligned trailing allocation and atomic reference counting, and adds concurrent-copy regression coverage. These focused development benchmarks are not acceptance cost observations.

candidate33_failed_cost.reason: Ordinary time passed but median peak RSS exceeded the unchanged 1.10 limit. Candidate 34 removes duplicate generic summary publications.

ownership_synchronization.note: The direct element-tag read exposes the race in the relaxed ownership check; the acquire variant passes. Initial string-only controls did not expose the race. The first detected report had external-symbolizer warnings; an explicit LLVM symbolizer gives the retained 66/0 control pair.

immutable_export_publication.note: Immutable generic exports share unchanged unit, database and checkpoint publications. Replacement and widening preserve prior readers. The 534495232-byte Lua probe overlapped builds and is excluded from acceptance timing; malloc logging was a bounded 180-second diagnostic run, not checked coverage.

candidate34_failed_cost.reason: Ordinary time passed; median peak RSS exceeded the unchanged 1.10 limit by 1145241.6 bytes. Candidate 35 extends immutable publications to specialized summaries and exact unchanged global projections.

immutable_specialized_publication.note: Generic and specialized exports, database indexes and checkpoint inputs retain immutable values. Keys remap independently. Memory summaries still use the original join and first-input normalization; publication reuse compares proof explanations as well as semantic facts. Report invalidation replaces its own value and preserves retained readers. A conditional initialization and assignment expression was split into explicit branches to satisfy strict static analysis.

development_cost_observation.reason: Lua timed out at 600.159 seconds without a completed report. Warm runs completed for four projects; Lua replay was interrupted after the failed cold observation.

partial_cost_observation.reason: Four projects completed; Lua was interrupted while the additional bounded static-layout cache was prepared. This is a partial development observation, not a failed timeout or an acceptance run.

subsequent_failed_cost_observations.reason: Lua exceeded the unchanged 600-second deadline without a completed report; the redundant warm Lua retry was interrupted.

observation.reason: Diagnostic completion run without cache, concurrent with builds/tests and a 15-second CPU profile; excluded from cost acceptance.

diagnostic_lua_completion.note: Candidate 23 completion for proof inspection only, with concurrent builds/tests and a short CPU profile. Excluded from all cost acceptance comparisons.

cache_eviction_validation.explanation: The initial new test byte budget held only one fully accounted large preparation. The corrected 1 MiB test still forces byte eviction while retaining a hot entry. Production budgets and contents were unchanged.

benchmark.note: Focused lookup benchmark; development builds were active, excluded from corpus acceptance cost.

place_lookup_optimization.note: Focused benchmark only; all corpus acceptance measurements remain separate. Lint corrections use designated initialization and explicitly document standard-library-required alias spellings.

benchmark.note: Focused path benchmark; development builds active, excluded from corpus acceptance cost.

path_storage_optimization.note: Shared paths retain exact ordering and detach before edits. One old union-path API call was corrected. A formatting command changed whitespace in three frozen headers; the guard rejected the population, exact recorded bytes were restored, all 58 hashes rechecked and regressions rerun without changing inventories or expectations. Intentional inspection of the guaranteed empty moved-from state is documented in the test lint exception.

provenance.regressions: Thirteen independent cases frozen during implementation.
provenance.followups: Three additional cases frozen separately during implementation.
provenance.rejection_properties: Final intended negative properties pinned separately from the original outcome-only baseline.
provenance.source_and_objects: Identical frozen C inputs. Primary objects are ordinary compilations; regression/upstream objects use unselected checked-report compilation, followed by checked linking selecting main.

limitations: Supported finite objects, buffers, chains and ownership forests; no arbitrary shared graphs or concurrency.
No whole-cJSON certification: selected public-header lifecycle clients only; parser/printer and incomplete generic contracts remain visible.
Direct entry allocation releases and unconditional wrapper composition; richer conditional forwarding and reassigned-entry projection may remain incomplete.
Unsupported private types, arbitrary type punning, mutual recursive inference, nonlocal jumps and asynchronous callbacks remain incomplete.
Old summary/sidecar/checkpoint artifacts require rebuilding; archive packaging and source-free proof artifacts remain separate work.
